rows.Kwic: 師各印可曰：汝等六人，同證吾身，各契其一。

Roles: approving master named in the question

Override.AttributionNote: Jinjiang Chan Lamp (錦江禪燈), Zhang Shangying biography. Doushuai Congyue is the exact speaker denoted by 悅 who asks whether, since Donglin Changzong approved the commissioner, Zhang Shangying still has any doubt about the words and teachings of buddhas and patriarchs. Zhang is the commissioner and addressee; Donglin is the named approving master.

rows.Kwic: 東林既印可運使，運使于佛祖言教有少疑否？
